STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_063864.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_063864.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_063864 (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input enable,
    input wire [31:0] glitch_delay,
    input wire [31:0] glitch_width,
    input wire [31:0] glitch_count,
    input wire [31:0] glitch_gap,
    input wire [31:0] glitch_max,
    input wire [31:0] reset_target,
    output reg glitched = 1'b0,
    input wire vstart,
    output reg vout = 1'b1,
    output wire finished,
    output wire reset_out
);

  parameter DELAY = 3'b000;
  parameter GLITCH = 3'b001;
  parameter GAP = 3'b010;

  reg [31:0] width_cnt = 32'd0;
  reg [31:0] cnt = 32'd0;
  reg [31:0] cycles = 32'd0;
  reg [31:0] reset_cnt = 32'd0;

  reg [ 2:0] state = DELAY;

  assign finished = (glitch_max && cycles == glitch_max);
  assign reset_out = !enable || !reset_target || state != DELAY || (enable && reset_target && state == DELAY && reset_cnt == reset_target);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!enable) begin
      state <= DELAY;
      if (!glitched) begin
        vout <= vstart;
      end
      width_cnt <= 32'd0;
      cnt <= 32'd0;
    end
    if (rst) begin
      state <= DELAY;
      vout <= vstart;
      width_cnt <= 32'd0;
      cnt <= 32'd0;
      glitched <= 1'b0;
      cycles <= 32'b0;
      reset_cnt <= 32'b0;
    end
    if (enable) begin
      glitched <= 1'b1;
      case (state)
        DELAY: begin
          vout <= 1'b1;
          if (reset_target && reset_cnt < reset_target) begin
            reset_cnt <= reset_cnt + 32'b1;
          end
          if (width_cnt == glitch_delay) begin
            state <= GLITCH;
            vout <= 1'b0;
            width_cnt <= 32'd0;
            reset_cnt <= 32'd0;
          end else begin
            width_cnt <= width_cnt + 32'b1;
          end
        end
        GLITCH: begin
          if (width_cnt == glitch_width - 1 || glitch_width == 0) begin
            width_cnt <= 32'd0;
            state <= GAP;
            vout <= 1'b1;
            cnt <= cnt + 32'b1;
            if (cnt == glitch_count - 1) begin
              cnt <= 32'd0;
              state <= DELAY;
              vout <= 1'b1;
              cycles <= cycles + 32'b1;
            end
          end else begin
            width_cnt <= width_cnt + 32'b1;
          end
        end
        GAP: begin
          if (width_cnt == glitch_gap - 1 || glitch_gap == 0) begin
            width_cnt <= 32'd0;
            state <= GLITCH;
            vout <= 1'b0;
          end else begin
            width_cnt <= width_cnt + 32'b1;
          end
        end
        default: begin
        end
      endcase
    end
  end
endmodule
